info.name: Echo
info.description: Reference plugin that echoes text back. Use it to try the ONE AI plugin contract.

command.name: echo
command.title: Echo text
command.description: Returns the text you send, unchanged.

command.name: reverse
command.title: Reverse text
command.description: Returns the text you send, reversed.

command.name: wait
command.title: Wait, then echo
command.description: Waits a few seconds (reporting progress), then returns the text. Shows cancellation and deadlines.
